summary: This bill reauthorizes the appropriation of $350,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2026 through 2031 for municipal grants related to sewer overflow control and stormwater reuse under the Federal Water Pollution Control Act.

scores.thoughts: This bill reauthorizes grants for sewer overflow and stormwater reuse, which directly addresses water pollution and improves water quality. This is a core environmental protection measure, making the topic central to the bill.
